visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and sunglasses stands on a sunny urban sidewalk in Los Angeles. He is wearing a black t-shirt and gesturing with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. In the background, there are street signs, trees, and passing cars. (2) The scene shifts to a Japanese-style cafe interior with light wood accents and warm lighting. A staff member is seen whisking bright green matcha in a ceramic bowl. (3) A close-up shows the green matcha being poured into a glass filled with ice and clear liquid on a weighing scale. (4) The man is back on screen, holding a glass of matcha and taking a sip with an appreciative expression. (5) He holds up a large, off-white WOKY brand tumbler, demonstrating its size and lid mechanism. (6) A series of quick cuts shows the man in different locations: inside a car while driving and outdoors in a park, always carrying the tumbler. (7) Close-up shots highlight the tumbler's different lid designs and the interior coating. (8) He is seen at a kitchen sink, demonstrating how easy the tumbler is to clean by hand. (9) Finally, he stands in a room with white walls, holding the tumbler and smiling, giving a thumbs-up motion.
